scope.coverage: 31 paired listings; 58/58 HTTP 200 responses and embedded JSON extracts

negative_findings.condition: AU description or appdata/raw HTML contains its paired Rakuten item URL, or Rakuten contains its paired AU item URL
negative_findings.evidence_scope: full embedded JSON serialization and complete raw HTML bodies for all paired captures
negative_findings.interpretation: No direct cross-mall product-link rule found. Generic brand/shop/category/recommendation links are not counted.

negative_findings.condition: same exact non-marketplace URL on both paired product pages, including manufacturer product pages, catalogue PDFs, or canonical original image URLs
negative_findings.evidence_scope: absolute URLs in all recursively traversed appdata strings and raw HTML
negative_findings.interpretation: No shared exact manufacturer URL, PDF, or canonical image URL found. Platform-hosted image URLs and similar filename/product-code strings are not URL matches.

negative_findings.condition: RA itemInfoSku.makerCreativeInfo.sku[].variantId yields an additional exact or model-prefix match in AU productImageUrls[]
negative_findings.interpretation: Where populated, makerCreativeInfo carries variant IDs (e.g. RA02 milbon7-1milbon1675; RA13/14 04-051kh; RA16 suffix variants), not shared manufacturer asset codes found in the AU product image URL list.

existing_code_field_observations.candidate_rule: RA itemInfoSku.sku[].attributes entry titled メーカー型番 equals a code in AU productImageUrls[]
existing_code_field_observations.status: corroboration only; these codes already occur in the captured AU product image paths and/or existing product descriptions, so this adds no independent deterministic condition beyond code matching already explored.

existing_code_field_observations.candidate_rule: RA manufacturer model attribute equals AU title/description text
existing_code_field_observations.status: same-product corroboration, but not new relative to existing model/title evidence.

existing_code_field_observations.candidate_rule: RA model attributes encode a new AU cross-page global identifier
existing_code_field_observations.detail: The seven RA メーカー型番 values are the same JANs already present in AU extraItemComment/extraItemCommentWithVideo; these duplicate the previously inspected JAN evidence rather than add a new field-level edge.

existing_code_field_observations.candidate_rule: RA makerCreativeInfo carries an additional manufacturer asset code
existing_code_field_observations.detail: Nonempty values are variant IDs; exact and suffix-stripped prefix checks against AU productImageUrls[] yielded no match. Empty makerCreativeInfo objects were ignored.

limits: Exact URL equality was evaluated; URL aliases, resized/proxied copies, and byte-level image similarity are not established by this exploration.
